title: Verify full-store export/import round-trip on a real Engram store
outcome: A coherent copy of the real Engram store survives the supported one-way full export/import with durable data, ids, links, history and resume behavior preserved. This is verification of the current migration route, not restoration of the retired coordinated prepare/activate/rollback protocol or predecessor-version chains.
acceptance: A coherent real Engram-store copy passes full export/import comparison, strict doctor, resume and history checks; nine project gates and the required independent review pair pass on the final input.

Current-format export/import preserves every durable data family and migration provenance, with populated round-trip and corruption refusal tests. Record ids and links remain unchanged; unexpected tables or columns are refused by name.

blockers.detail: Completion accounting awaits the required verification branch's historical tests-first acceptance decision. Implementation and correction children are reconciled; the separately deferred report-counter documentation remains open. No install/cutover is implied.
